postToolUse.prompt: A file was just written. Review the tool input in $ARGUMENTS. If the file path contains 'knowledge-base' or 'dingtalk-docs', do the following: 1) Verify the file landed in the correct subdirectory based on the auto-classify rule (00-index, 01-projects, 02-topics, 03-meetings, 04-decisions, 05-references, or dingtalk-docs). 2) Check if knowledge-base/00-index/INDEX.md needs updating - if the file is new (not a template or INDEX.md itself), return additional_context reminding the agent to add an entry to INDEX.md. 3) If the file does NOT belong to knowledge-base or dingtalk-docs, return empty additional_context. Keep the response concise.
